name: Nissan 370Z (Z34) - OBD port CAN, 500k
_help: Each signal: id (hex), start byte (0 = first), length in bytes, endian big|little,
optional signed, scale, offset, shift, mask, map {raw: value}. value = raw * scale + offset.
Channels: rpm speed coolant oil_temp intake_temp throttle battery fuel gear steering brake lat_g lon_g.
Sources: community reverse engineering of a 2010 370Z (github.com/Knio/carhack). Scales marked
'verify' are best guesses - check them in the CAN sniffer against the factory cluster and edit here.
Set "disabled": true to switch a signal off.

signals.note: ECM. Same value as 0x1F9 bytes 2-3; raw/8 = rpm (idle ~680)
ABS/VDC vehicle speed km/h - verify scale against the cluster
Coolant temp, raw - 40 = deg C - verify offset
6MT lever position. Remove this entry to fall back to rpm/speed gear estimation
Steering angle deg, byte 1 is the high byte - verify sign/scale
